methods.steps: Choose Insert > Image to place the PNG, then File > Export As > Export as EPUB.
methods.limits: Choose fixed or reflowable layout deliberately; image pixels do not become editable paragraphs.

methods.steps: Create page.md containing ![Image description](picture.png), then run pandoc page.md -o book.epub.
methods.limits: This builds an image-containing publication from Markdown; it does not recognize words in the image.

methods.steps: Click the Insert Media button, choose Photos or Videos to pick the PNG, then choose File > Export To > EPUB.
methods.limits: The document type and export settings determine fixed or reflowable layout.

methods.steps: Choose File > Open and pick the PNG, then choose File > Save as PSD.
methods.limits: A flattened PNG has no hidden text or layers to restore.

methods.steps: Run magick artwork.png artwork.psd.
methods.limits: A format change cannot separate baked-in objects.

methods.steps: Run magick diagram.svg diagram.webp.
methods.limits: Its SVG renderer determines how the drawing looks.

methods.steps: Export the SVG as PNG in Inkscape with File > Export PNG Image, choosing the area and size, then run cwebp -lossless diagram.png -o diagram.webp.
methods.limits: Two-stage raster workflow; cwebp does not read SVG directly.

methods.steps: Run magick "scan.tiff[0]" scan.jpeg.
methods.limits: The bracketed number picks the image to read, starting at 0; use another number for another page.

methods.steps: Run sips -s format jpeg scan.tiff --out scan.jpg in Terminal.
methods.limits: The format option lists tiff and jpeg among its values.

methods.steps: Run avifdec illustration.avif illustration.png, then bring the PNG into Inkscape with File > Import and choose to embed it.
methods.limits: The result contains a raster image unless you separately trace it.

methods.steps: Open the AVIF in GIMP and use File > Export As to save a PNG; import that PNG in Inkscape, select it, choose Path > Trace Bitmap and click Ok.
methods.limits: The trace appears over the original bitmap.

methods.steps: Run magick mark.avif mark.bmp, then potrace -s mark.bmp -o mark.svg.
methods.limits: Potrace takes bitmap input and has a black level cutoff setting.

methods.steps: Open the drawing and choose File > Export; pick SVG from the Save as type list, then set the compatibility, encoding and text options.
methods.limits: Objects with mesh fills or drop shadows are exported as bitmaps; text can be exported as characters or curves.

methods.steps: Open a supported CDR, then save and choose the .svg (Plain SVG) type.
methods.limits: Its documented import list names CorelDRAW 7–X4; not every newer drawing or effect is guaranteed.

methods.steps: Run soffice --convert-to svg drawing.cdr.
methods.limits: LibreOffice imports CDR through libcdr; its filter list includes an SVG export filter.

methods.steps: Run magick "reaction.gif[0]" reaction.jpeg.
methods.limits: The bracketed number picks the frame to read, starting at 0.

methods.steps: Open the GIF, choose File > Export, choose JPEG from the Format pop-up menu, then click Save.
methods.limits: Open several files in one window and select them in the sidebar to convert together.

methods.steps: Open the JPEG, choose File > Export As, export it as a GIF and confirm the options in the GIF Export dialog.
methods.limits: GIMP exports a GIF with at most 256 colors, which can change gradients.

methods.steps: Run magick photo.jpeg photo.gif.
methods.limits: This gives a still GIF from a still image.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i voice.mp3 -c:a pcm_s16be voice.aiff.
methods.limits: Decodes the MP3 to 16-bit big-endian PCM; it does not restore discarded source detail.

methods.steps: Choose Music > Settings > Files > Import Settings and set Import Using to AIFF; select the songs, then File > Convert > Create AIFF Version.
methods.limits: The song takes up much more space and sounds the same as the MP3.

methods.steps: Choose Edit > Preferences > General > Import Settings, set Import Using to AIFF Encoder, select the song, then File > Convert > Create AIFF Version.
methods.limits: Apple limits conversion of store purchases to iTunes Plus songs.
